bool  ema_up    = min_slope <= 0 or ema_slope > min_slope
bool  ema_dn    = min_slope <= 0 or ema_slope < -min_slope

indicators.name: Volume Profile With Delta
indicators.source:
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if array.size(arr) != rows
            array.clear(arr)
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.push(arr, 0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.set(arr, i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                array.set(vol_total, r, array.get(vol_total, r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    array.set(vol_up, r, array.get(vol_up, r) + per_row)
                else
                    array.set(vol_dn, r, array.get(vol_dn, r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = array.get(vol_total, r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = array.get(vol_up, poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = array.get(vol_dn, poc_row)
    float poc_tot = array.get(vol_total, poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price     = na
float poc_hi        = na
float poc_lo        = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row       = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue
        float bar_lo = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]
        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1
        if span <= 0
            continue
        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up_vol = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn_vol = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot    = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct    := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up_vol - poc_dn_vol) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

indicators.source:
var int armed_dir = 0

// Arm when price leaves POC with delta + trend alignment
if above_poc and ema_up and delta_bull and price_above_ema
    armed_dir := 1
else if below_poc and ema_dn and delta_bear and price_below_ema
    armed_dir := -1

// Disarm if price returns fully inside POC
if armed_dir == 1 and not na(poc_lo) and close <= poc_lo
    armed_dir := 0
else if armed_dir == -1 and not na(poc_hi) and close >= poc_hi
    armed_dir := 0

// Entry: armed long + 5 EMA crosses above 75 EMA (pullback resolved, momentum resuming up)
// Entry: armed short + 5 EMA crosses below 75 EMA (pullback resolved, momentum resuming down)
bool confirmed_long  = armed_dir == 1 and ema5_cross_above
bool confirmed_short = armed_dir == -1 and ema5_cross_below

var int last_trade_bar = -9999
bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars
bool under_max_trades = session_trades < max_trades_session

bool long_sig  = confirmed_long and in_session and cooled_down and under_max_trades and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = confirmed_short and in_session and cooled_down and under_max_trades and strategy.position_size >= 0

bool bull_pin = close > open and lower_wick > body * 2 and upper_wick < body and full_range > 0

// Bearish pin bar: long upper wick, small body at bottom, closed red
bool bear_pin = close < open and upper_wick > body * 2 and lower_wick < body and full_range > 0

// Bullish engulfing: prev red, current green, current body wraps prev body
bool bull_engulf = close > open and close[1] < open[1] and close > open[1] and open < close[1]

// Bearish engulfing: prev green, current red, current body wraps prev body
bool bear_engulf = close < open and close[1] > open[1] and close < open[1] and open > close[1]

bool bull_signal = bull_pin or bull_engulf
bool bear_signal = bear_pin or bear_engulf

// Simple Volume Profile Approximation using Highest Volume Node (HVN) over lookback
// Since true volume profile requires histogram, we approximate POC as the price level with highest volume in the lookback period
// For simplicity and robustness in Pine, we use the average price of the highest volume bar as a proxy for POC
float poc_price = na
float poc_hi = na
float poc_lo = na
float delta_pct = 0.0

// Calculate Volume Profile Proxy
// Find the bar with max volume in lookback
int max_vol_idx = na
float max_vol = 0.0
for i = 1 to profile_lookback
    if volume[i] > max_vol
        max_vol := volume[i]
        max_vol_idx := i

if not na(max_vol_idx)
    // Use the high/low of the max volume bar as the POC range
    poc_price := (high[max_vol_idx] + low[max_vol_idx]) / 2
    poc_hi := high[max_vol_idx]
    poc_lo := low[max_vol_idx]

    // Calculate Delta Imbalance Proxy
    // Bullish if close > open and volume is high
    // Bearish if close < open and volume is high
    float bull_vol = 0.0
    float bear_vol = 0.0
    for i = 1 to profile_lookback
        if close[i] > open[i]
            bull_vol += volume[i]
        else if close[i] < open[i]
            bear_vol += volume[i]
    float total_vol = bull_vol + bear_vol
    if total_vol > 0
        delta_pct := (bull_vol - bear_vol) / total_vol * 100

if phase == 0 and strategy.position_size == 0
    gather_count += 1

    if na(set_high) or high > set_high
        set_high := high
    if na(set_low) or low < set_low
        set_low := low

    if gather_count >= set_size
        bool is_green = close > open
        bool is_red   = close < open
        bool is_doji  = math.abs(close - open) <= doji_threshold

        if is_doji
            log.info("SET COMPLETE (DOJI): high={0} low={1} — skipping bar={2}", set_high, set_low, bar_index)
            gather_count := 0
            set_high     := na
            set_low      := na
        else
            signal_dir  := is_green ? 1 : -1
            phase       := 1
            watch_count := 0
            log.info("SET COMPLETE: high={0} low={1} dir={2} bar={3}",
              set_high, set_low, signal_dir > 0 ? "UP" : "DOWN", bar_index)

    watch_count += 1

        phase        := 0
        gather_count := 0
        set_high     := na
        set_low      := na
        signal_dir   := 0

        peak_profit_pts := 0.0
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
        if hard_tp_pts > 0

        log.info("ENTRY SHORT: close={0} setLow={1} stop={2} bar={3}",

        phase        := 0
        gather_count := 0
        set_high     := na

        signal_dir   := 0

indicators.name: Sma Trend
indicators.source:
sma_val          = ta.sma(close, sma_len)
float sma_now    = sma_val
float sma_prev   = sma_val[sma_slope_bars]
float sma_rise   = sma_now - sma_prev
float sma_angle  = math.todegrees(math.atan(sma_rise / sma_slope_bars))

bool sma_up      = sma_angle >= sma_min_angle and close > sma_val
bool sma_down    = sma_angle <= -sma_min_angle and close < sma_val

htf_ema          = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, htf_timeframe, ta.ema(close, 50), barmerge.gaps_off, barmerge.lookahead_off)

htf_bearish      = htf_close < htf_ema

indicators.name: Fvg Detection
indicators.source:
bull_fvg_top     = low
bull_fvg_bot     = high[2]
bull_fvg_valid   = high[2] < low

bear_fvg_top     = low[2]
bear_fvg_bot     = high
bear_fvg_valid   = low[2] > high

// Middle candle momentum check
avg_body         = (math.abs(close[1] - open[1]) + math.abs(close[2] - open[2]) + math.abs(close[3] - open[3])) / 3
mid_body         = math.abs(close[1] - open[1])
has_momentum     = avg_body > 0 and mid_body >= avg_body * min_body_ratio

bull_trend_ok    = not require_trend or (close[1] > open[1])
bear_trend_ok    = not require_trend or (close[1] < open[1])

// Min gap size filter
min_gap_pts      = atr_val * (min_gap_pct / 100.0)
bull_gap_ok      = bull_fvg_valid and (bull_fvg_top - bull_fvg_bot) >= min_gap_pts
bear_gap_ok      = bear_fvg_valid and (bear_fvg_top - bear_fvg_bot) >= min_gap_pts

bool bear_fvg = high[2] < low and (low - high[2]) >= atr * fvg_min_atr

// Recent FVG: rolling counter when FVG detected
var int recent_bull_cnt = 0
var int recent_bear_cnt = 0
if bull_fvg
    recent_bull_cnt := fvg_lookback
else if recent_bull_cnt > 0
    recent_bull_cnt := recent_bull_cnt - 1
if bear_fvg
    recent_bear_cnt := fvg_lookback
else if recent_bear_cnt > 0
    recent_bear_cnt := recent_bear_cnt - 1

bool recent_bull_fvg = recent_bull_cnt > 0
bool recent_bear_fvg = recent_bear_cnt > 0

var int   last_bear_bar  = -999

// Register new bullish FVG (replaces any previous one)
if bull_fvg_valid and bull_gap_ok and has_momentum and bull_trend_ok
    last_bull_top := bull_fvg_top
    last_bull_bot := bull_fvg_bot
    last_bull_bar := bar_index
    bull_invalid  := false
    bull_used     := false

// Register new bearish FVG

    last_bear_top := bear_fvg_top
    last_bear_bot := bear_fvg_bot
    last_bear_bar := bar_index
    bear_invalid  := false
    bear_used     := false

// Snapshot "still active" BEFORE invalidation runs (needed for failure breakout)
bool bull_still_alive = not na(last_bull_top) and not bull_invalid and not bull_used and (bar_index - last_bull_bar) <= fvg_lookback and bar_index > last_bull_bar
bool bear_still_alive = not na(last_bear_top) and not bear_invalid and not bear_used and (bar_index - last_bear_bar) <= fvg_lookback and bar_index > last_bear_bar

// FAILURE BREAKOUT: FVG was still active but price broke DECISIVELY through.
// Requires candle body fully through the zone + fail_break_pts buffer.
// Bull FVG broken downward → SHORT (bullish gap failed, confirms bears)
// Bear FVG broken upward  → LONG  (bearish gap failed, confirms bulls)
bool bull_fail_short = entry_type == "Breakout" and bull_still_alive and close < last_bull_bot - fail_break_pts and open < last_bull_bot
bool bear_fail_long  = entry_type == "Breakout" and bear_still_alive and close > last_bear_top + fail_break_pts and open > last_bear_top

// Invalidate: price closes CLEARLY through the gap (must exceed fail_break_pts).
// Zone stays valid until a decisive break -- not killed by wicks or marginal closes.
if not na(last_bull_bot) and close < last_bull_bot - fail_break_pts and open < last_bull_bot
    bull_invalid := true
if not na(last_bear_top) and close > last_bear_top + fail_break_pts and open > last_bear_top
    bear_invalid := true

// Active = not expired, not invalidated, not already traded
bull_fvg_active  = not na(last_bull_top) and not bull_invalid and not bull_used and (bar_index - last_bull_bar) <= fvg_lookback
bear_fvg_active  = not na(last_bear_top) and not bear_invalid and not bear_used and (bar_index - last_bear_bar) <= fvg_lookback

indicators.name: Volume Profile + Delta (Closed Bars Only = No Repaint)
indicators.signature: Volume Profile + Delta (Closed Bars Only = No Repaint)
indicators.source:
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows
int lb_closed = math.max(0, lb - 1)
float prof_hi   = lb_closed >= 1 ? ta.highest(high[1], lb_closed) : high
float prof_lo   = lb_closed >= 1 ? ta.lowest(low[1], lb_closed) : low
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price    = na
float poc_hi       = na
float poc_lo       = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row      = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 2
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if array.size(arr) != rows
            array.clear(arr)
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.push(arr, 0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.set(arr, i, 0.0)
    for iBar = 1 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue
        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]
        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1
        if span <= 0
            continue
        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                array.set(vol_total, r, array.get(vol_total, r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    array.set(vol_up, r, array.get(vol_up, r) + per_row)
                else
                    array.set(vol_dn, r, array.get(vol_dn, r) + per_row)
    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = array.get(vol_total, r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r
    poc_price    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo       := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi       := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size
    float poc_up  = array.get(vol_up, poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = array.get(vol_dn, poc_row)
    float poc_tot = array.get(vol_total, poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

int conf_long  = 0
int conf_short = 0

// 1) ATR above threshold
bool atr_ok = not na(atr_val) and atr_val >= atr_threshold
if atr_ok
    conf_long  += 1
    conf_short += 1

// 2) Trend direction
if trend == 1
    conf_long += 1
if trend == -1
    conf_short += 1

// 3) Pullback near slow EMA
float dist_to_slow = close - slow_ma
bool pullback_long  = trend == 1 and math.abs(dist_to_slow) <= pullback_buffer
bool pullback_short = trend == -1 and math.abs(dist_to_slow) <= pullback_buffer
if pullback_long
    conf_long += 1
if pullback_short
    conf_short += 1

// 4) MACD histogram momentum (growing in trade direction)
bool macd_mom_long  = hist > hist[1] and hist > 0
bool macd_mom_short = hist < hist[1] and hist < 0
if macd_mom_long
    conf_long += 1
if macd_mom_short
    conf_short += 1

// 5) Fast MA still above/below slow (trend intact)
if fast_ma > slow_ma
    conf_long += 1
if fast_ma < slow_ma
    conf_short += 1

float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivot_left, pivot_right)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(low,  pivot_left, pivot_right)

var array<float> recent_ph = array.new_float(0)
var array<float> recent_pl = array.new_float(0)

if not na(ph)
    recent_ph.push(ph)
    if recent_ph.size() > pivot_count
        recent_ph.shift()

if not na(pl)
    recent_pl.push(pl)
    if recent_pl.size() > pivot_count
        recent_pl.shift()

// Lower highs: each successive pivot high is strictly lower
bool has_lower_highs = recent_ph.size() >= pivot_count
if has_lower_highs
    for k = 1 to recent_ph.size() - 1
        if recent_ph.get(k) >= recent_ph.get(k - 1)
            has_lower_highs := false
            break

// Higher lows: each successive pivot low is strictly higher
bool has_higher_lows = recent_pl.size() >= pivot_count
if has_higher_lows
    for k = 1 to recent_pl.size() - 1
        if recent_pl.get(k) <= recent_pl.get(k - 1)
            has_higher_lows := false
            break

bool pivot_ok_long  = not use_pivot_filter or has_higher_lows
bool pivot_ok_short = not use_pivot_filter or has_lower_highs

indicators.name: Volume Profile + Delta
indicators.source:
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows
float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price    = na
float poc_hi       = na
float poc_lo       = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row      = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if array.size(arr) != rows
            array.clear(arr)
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.push(arr, 0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                array.set(arr, i, 0.0)
    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue
        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]
        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1
        if span <= 0
            continue
        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                array.set(vol_total, r, array.get(vol_total, r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    array.set(vol_up, r, array.get(vol_up, r) + per_row)
                else
                    array.set(vol_dn, r, array.get(vol_dn, r) + per_row)
    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = array.get(vol_total, r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r
    poc_price    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo       := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi       := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size
    float p_up  = array.get(vol_up, poc_row)
    float p_dn  = array.get(vol_dn, poc_row)
    float p_tot = array.get(vol_total, poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := p_tot > 0 ? ((p_up - p_dn) / p_tot) * 100 : 0.0

atr_val  = ta.atr(sensitivity)
up_level = hl2 - (sensitivity * 0.3) * atr_val
dn_level = hl2 + (sensitivity * 0.3) * atr_val

var float trail = na
var int   trend = 1

trail := na(trail) ? hl2 : trail

if trend == 1
    if close < trail
        trend := -1
        trail := dn_level
    else
        trail := math.max(trail, up_level)
else
    if close > trail
        trend := 1
        trail := up_level
    else
        trail := math.min(trail, dn_level)

indicators.signature: Arm On Poc Breakout + Trail, Enter On Pivot
indicators.source:
var int armed_dir = 0

if above_poc and vwma_up and delta_bull and trail_bull
    armed_dir := 1
else if below_poc and vwma_dn and delta_bear and trail_bear
    armed_dir := -1

if armed_dir == 1 and not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo)
    if disarm_only_inside_poc
        if close <= poc_lo
            armed_dir := 0
    else if close <= poc_hi
        armed_dir := 0
else if armed_dir == -1 and not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo)
    if disarm_only_inside_poc
        if close >= poc_hi
            armed_dir := 0
    else if close >= poc_lo
        armed_dir := 0

// Disarm if Smart Trail flips against armed direction
if require_trail
    if armed_dir == 1 and trend == -1
        armed_dir := 0
    if armed_dir == -1 and trend == 1
        armed_dir := 0

bool pivot_confirm_long  = armed_dir == 1 and not na(ph)
bool pivot_confirm_short = armed_dir == -1 and not na(pl)

bool price_ok_long  = not use_price_vwma or close > vwma_val
bool price_ok_short = not use_price_vwma or close < vwma_val
bool vol_ok         = not use_vol_filter or high_vol

bool confirmed_long  = pivot_confirm_long and price_ok_long and vol_ok
bool confirmed_short = pivot_confirm_short and price_ok_short and vol_ok

bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars

bool long_sig  = confirmed_long and in_session and cooled_down and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = confirmed_short and in_session and cooled_down and strategy.position_size >= 0

indicators.name: Ai Classification
indicators.source:
rsi_val   = ta.rsi(close, 14)
vol_check = volume > ta.sma(volume, 20)

get_ai_score(is_buy) =>
    score = 2
    if is_buy
        if rsi_val > 60 and vol_check
            score := 4
        else if rsi_val > 50
            score := 3
        else
            score := 1
    else
        if rsi_val < 40 and vol_check
            score := 4
        else if rsi_val < 50
            score := 3
        else
            score := 1
    score

ai_score  = above_channel ? get_ai_score(true) : below_channel ? get_ai_score(false) : 0
is_strong = ai_score >= 3

indicators.name: Breakout Mode (Phase 0/1/2)
indicators.source:
if not range_mode
    if ts.phase == 0 and show_w1 and in_session
        if close > lock_w1_hi
            ts.phase        := 1
            ts.breakout_dir := 1
            ts.gather_start := bar_index + 1
            ts.gather_hi    := na
            ts.gather_lo    := na
            log.info("BREAKOUT BULL bar={0} close={1} w1_hi={2}", bar_index, close, lock_w1_hi)
        else if close < lock_w1_lo
            ts.phase        := 1
            ts.breakout_dir := -1
            ts.gather_start := bar_index + 1
            ts.gather_hi    := na
            ts.gather_lo    := na
            log.info("BREAKOUT BEAR bar={0} close={1} w1_lo={2}", bar_index, close, lock_w1_lo)

    else if ts.phase == 1 and bar_index >= ts.gather_start
        int bars_in = bar_index - ts.gather_start
        if bars_in == 0
            ts.gather_hi := high
            ts.gather_lo := low
        else
            ts.gather_hi := math.max(ts.gather_hi, high)
            ts.gather_lo := math.min(ts.gather_lo, low)
        if bars_in >= gather_len - 1
            ts.phase := 2
            ts.watch_start := bar_index + 1
            log.info("GATHER DONE bar={0} hi={1} lo={2}", bar_index, ts.gather_hi, ts.gather_lo)

    else if ts.phase == 2 and bar_index >= ts.watch_start and in_session and strategy.position_size == 0
        if ts.breakout_dir == -1
            if close >= ts.gather_lo and close <= ts.gather_lo + bounce_pts
                current_stop    := close - stop_pts
                peak_profit_pts := 0.0
                if allow_trades
                    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
                    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=current_stop, limit=close + tp_pts)
                ts.phase := 3
                log.info("BOUNCE LONG bar={0} close={1} gather_lo={2}", bar_index, close, ts.gather_lo)
            else if close < ts.gather_lo or close > ts.gather_hi
                ts.phase := 3
                log.info("GATHER INVALIDATED bar={0} close={1} hi={2} lo={3}", bar_index, close, ts.gather_hi, ts.gather_lo)
        else if ts.breakout_dir == 1
            if close <= ts.gather_hi and close >= ts.gather_hi - bounce_pts
                current_stop    := close + stop_pts
                peak_profit_pts := 0.0
                if allow_trades
                    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
                    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=current_stop, limit=close - tp_pts)
                ts.phase := 3
                log.info("BOUNCE SHORT bar={0} close={1} gather_hi={2}", bar_index, close, ts.gather_hi)
            else if close > ts.gather_hi or close < ts.gather_lo
                ts.phase := 3
                log.info("GATHER INVALIDATED bar={0} close={1} hi={2} lo={3}", bar_index, close, ts.gather_hi, ts.gather_lo)

indicators.name: Range Mode: Bounce Trades
indicators.source:
if range_mode and range_ready and in_session and ts.phase != 3 and strategy.position_size == 0
    bool at_resistance = close <= range_hi and close >= range_hi - bounce_pts
    bool at_support    = close >= range_lo and close <= range_lo + bounce_pts

int lb = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_row = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

int cur_row = na
int prev_row = na
bool cur_is_lvn = false
bool prev_is_hvn = false
float poc_price = na

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    if vol_row.size() != rows
        vol_row.clear()
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_row.push(0.0)
    else
        for i = 0 to rows - 1
            vol_row.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi = high[iBar]
        float mid = (bar_hi + bar_lo) / 2.0

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float mu = 0.5
        float sum_w = 0.0

        for k = 0 to span - 1
            float t = span == 1 ? 0.5 : k / (span - 1.0)
            float z = (t - mu) / gauss_sigma
            float w = math.exp(-0.5 * z * z)
            sum_w += w

        if sum_w <= 0
            continue

        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                float t = span == 1 ? 0.5 : k / (span - 1.0)
                float z = (t - mu) / gauss_sigma
                float w = math.exp(-0.5 * z * z)
                float contrib = bar_vol * (w / sum_w)
                vol_row.set(r, vol_row.get(r) + contrib)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    int poc_row = 0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_row.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size

    float threshold = max_vol * lvn_thresh

    int row_now = math.min(math.max(math.floor((close - prof_lo) / step_size), 0), rows - 1)
    int row_prev = math.min(math.max(math.floor((close[1] - prof_lo) / step_size), 0), rows - 1)

    cur_row := row_now
    prev_row := row_prev

    float vol_now = vol_row.get(row_now)
    float vol_prev = vol_row.get(row_prev)

    cur_is_lvn := vol_now < threshold
    prev_is_hvn := vol_prev >= threshold

    array.set(up_vols, i, 0.0)
    array.set(down_vols, i, 0.0)

float high_range = ta.highest(high, profile_lookback)
float low_range  = ta.lowest(low, profile_lookback)
float range_size = high_range - low_range
float bin_size   = range_size / bin_count

// Iterate through lookback bars to build profile
for i = 0 to profile_lookback - 1
    float price = close[i]
    // Map price to bin index
    int bin_idx = math.floor((price - low_range) / bin_size)
    // Clamp bin index
    if bin_idx < 0
        bin_idx := 0
    if bin_idx >= bin_count
        bin_idx := bin_count - 1

    float vol = volume[i]
    if close[i] > open[i]
        array.set(up_vols, bin_idx, array.get(up_vols, bin_idx) + vol)
    else
        array.set(down_vols, bin_idx, array.get(down_vols, bin_idx) + vol)

        max_vol := total_vol
        poc_idx := i

float poc_down_vol = array.get(down_vols, poc_idx)

        float ema_k = ema_val[k]
        if na(ema_k)
            all_above := false
            all_below := false
            break
        if body_lo <= ema_k
            all_above := false
        if body_hi >= ema_k
            all_below := false
    if all_above
        ema_signal := 2
    else if all_below
        ema_signal := 1

indicators.name: Bos Detection
indicators.source:
var int bos_signal = 0  // 2 = bullish, 1 = bearish
var int bos_pivot_ref = -1
var float bos_level = na

bos_signal := 0
bos_pivot_ref := -1
bos_level := na

int pw = pivot_window
int bc = backcandles
int piv_end_offset = pw  // confirmed pivots must be at least this many bars back

// Collect confirmed pivots
if bar_index >= bc
    // Arrays for pivot highs and lows (index, value)
    var array<int> ph_idx_arr = array.new_int(0)
    var array<float> ph_val_arr = array.new_float(0)
    var array<int> pl_idx_arr = array.new_int(0)
    var array<float> pl_val_arr = array.new_float(0)

    array.clear(ph_idx_arr)
    array.clear(ph_val_arr)
    array.clear(pl_idx_arr)
    array.clear(pl_val_arr)

    for j = bc to piv_end_offset
        int offset = j
        // Check if this bar is a pivot high
        bool is_ph = true
        bool is_pl = true
        float hi_j = high[offset]
        float lo_j = low[offset]

        for side = 1 to pw
            if high[offset - side] > hi_j or high[offset + side] > hi_j
                is_ph := false
            if low[offset - side] < lo_j or low[offset + side] < lo_j
                is_pl := false

        if is_ph
            array.push(ph_idx_arr, offset)
            array.push(ph_val_arr, hi_j)
        if is_pl
            array.push(pl_idx_arr, offset)
            array.push(pl_val_arr, lo_j)

    // Bullish BOS: latest PH, PLs before and after, PL_after sweeps below PL_before, first close above PH
    if array.size(ph_idx_arr) > 0
        int latest_ph_offset = array.get(ph_idx_arr, array.size(ph_idx_arr) - 1)
        float latest_ph_val = array.get(ph_val_arr, array.size(ph_val_arr) - 1)

        if close > latest_ph_val and close[1] <= latest_ph_val and array.size(pl_idx_arr) > 0
            float pl_before_val = na
            int   pl_before_off = 99999
            float pl_after_val = na
            bool has_pl_before = false
            bool has_pl_after = false

            for k = 0 to array.size(pl_idx_arr) - 1
                int pl_off = array.get(pl_idx_arr, k)
                float pl_v = array.get(pl_val_arr, k)
                if pl_off > latest_ph_offset
                    if pl_off < pl_before_off
                        pl_before_off := pl_off
                        pl_before_val := pl_v
                    has_pl_before := true
                else if pl_off < latest_ph_offset
                    if not has_pl_after or pl_v < pl_after_val
                        pl_after_val := pl_v
                    has_pl_after := true

            if has_pl_before and has_pl_after and pl_after_val < pl_before_val
                bos_signal := 2
                bos_pivot_ref := latest_ph_offset
                bos_level := latest_ph_val

    // Bearish BOS: latest PL, PHs before and after, PH_after sweeps above PH_before, first close below PL
    if bos_signal == 0 and array.size(pl_idx_arr) > 0
        int latest_pl_offset = array.get(pl_idx_arr, array.size(pl_idx_arr) - 1)
        float latest_pl_val = array.get(pl_val_arr, array.size(pl_val_arr) - 1)

        if close < latest_pl_val and close[1] >= latest_pl_val and array.size(ph_idx_arr) > 0
            float ph_before_val = na
            int   ph_before_off = 99999
            float ph_after_val = na
            bool has_ph_before = false
            bool has_ph_after = false

            for k = 0 to array.size(ph_idx_arr) - 1
                int ph_off = array.get(ph_idx_arr, k)
                float ph_v = array.get(ph_val_arr, k)
                if ph_off > latest_pl_offset
                    if ph_off < ph_before_off
                        ph_before_off := ph_off
                        ph_before_val := ph_v
                    has_ph_before := true
                else if ph_off < latest_pl_offset
                    if not has_ph_after or ph_v > ph_after_val
                        ph_after_val := ph_v
                    has_ph_after := true

            if has_ph_before and has_ph_after and ph_after_val > ph_before_val
                bos_signal := 1
                bos_pivot_ref := latest_pl_offset
                bos_level := latest_pl_val

// Apply EMA filter
if use_ema_filter and bos_signal != 0 and ema_signal != bos_signal
    bos_signal := 0
    bos_pivot_ref := -1
    bos_level := na

indicators.name: Bos State Machine
indicators.source:
var int   phase           = 0
var float swing_hi        = na
var float swing_lo        = na
var float structure_level = na
var float post_bos_lo     = na
var float post_bos_hi     = na
var bool  post_bos_pulled = false

if above_poc and ema_up and delta_bull and phase == 0
    phase := 1
    swing_hi := high
    swing_lo := na
    structure_level := na
    post_bos_lo := na
    post_bos_pulled := false
else if below_poc and ema_dn and delta_bear and phase == 0
    phase := -1
    swing_lo := low
    swing_hi := na
    structure_level := na
    post_bos_hi := na
    post_bos_pulled := false

bool long_sig  = false
bool short_sig = false

if phase == 1 and strategy.position_size == 0
    if high > nz(swing_hi, high)
        swing_hi := high
    if close < nz(swing_hi)
        structure_level := swing_hi
    if not na(structure_level) and close > structure_level
        phase := 2
        post_bos_lo := low
        post_bos_pulled := false
else if phase == 2 and strategy.position_size == 0
    if low < nz(post_bos_lo, low)
        post_bos_lo := low
    if close > open and low <= nz(post_bos_lo) + pullback_margin
        post_bos_pulled := true
    if post_bos_pulled and close > open
        long_sig := true
else if phase == -1 and strategy.position_size == 0
    if low < nz(swing_lo, low)
        swing_lo := low
    if close > nz(swing_lo)
        structure_level := swing_lo
    if not na(structure_level) and close < structure_level
        phase := -2
        post_bos_hi := high
        post_bos_pulled := false
else if phase == -2 and strategy.position_size == 0
    if high > nz(post_bos_hi, high)
        post_bos_hi := high
    if close < open and high >= nz(post_bos_hi) - pullback_margin
        post_bos_pulled := true
    if post_bos_pulled and close < open
        short_sig := true

if phase != 0 and strategy.position_size == 0
    if phase > 0 and not na(poc_hi) and close <= poc_hi
        phase := 0
    else if phase < 0 and not na(poc_lo) and close >= poc_lo
        phase := 0

var int last_trade_bar = -9999
bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars
long_sig  := long_sig and in_session and cooled_down and strategy.position_size == 0
short_sig := short_sig and in_session and cooled_down and strategy.position_size == 0

indicators.source:
var array<float> hist_poc_price = array.new_float(0)
var array<float> hist_poc_hi    = array.new_float(0)
var array<float> hist_poc_lo    = array.new_float(0)
var array<float> hist_poc_delta = array.new_float(0)
var float last_rec_poc = na

if not na(poc_price)
    bool is_new_poc = na(last_rec_poc) or math.abs(poc_price - last_rec_poc) >= poc_shift_pts
    if is_new_poc
        if not na(last_rec_poc)
            float half_step = not na(step_size) ? step_size / 2 : 0.5
            array.unshift(hist_poc_price, last_rec_poc)
            array.unshift(hist_poc_hi, last_rec_poc + half_step)
            array.unshift(hist_poc_lo, last_rec_poc - half_step)
            array.unshift(hist_poc_delta, nz(poc_delta_pct))
            while array.size(hist_poc_price) > poc_history_count
                array.pop(hist_poc_price)
                array.pop(hist_poc_hi)
                array.pop(hist_poc_lo)
                array.pop(hist_poc_delta)
        last_rec_poc := poc_price

int hist_size = array.size(hist_poc_price)

indicators.name: S/R Touch Detection + Nearest Levels
indicators.source:
bool hit_support    = false
bool hit_resistance = false
float nearest_support    = na
float nearest_resistance = na

if hist_size > 0
    for k = 0 to hist_size - 1
        float poc_h = array.get(hist_poc_hi, k)
        float poc_l = array.get(hist_poc_lo, k)
        float poc_p = array.get(hist_poc_price, k)
        if poc_h < close and low <= poc_h + sr_zone_pts and close > poc_h
            hit_support := true
        if poc_l > close and high >= poc_l - sr_zone_pts and close < poc_l
            hit_resistance := true
        // Track nearest S/R for display
        if poc_p < close and (na(nearest_support) or poc_p > nearest_support)
            nearest_support := poc_p
        if poc_p > close and (na(nearest_resistance) or poc_p < nearest_resistance)
            nearest_resistance := poc_p

indicators.source:
bool   hit_support    = false
float  support_level  = na
float  next_res_above = na  // nearest historical POC above entry for TP target

bool   hit_resistance = false
float  resist_level   = na
float  next_sup_below = na  // nearest historical POC below entry for TP target

if hist_size > 0
    float best_sup_dist = 99999.0
    float best_res_dist = 99999.0

    for k = 0 to hist_size - 1
        float poc_mid = array.get(hist_poc_price, k)
        float poc_h   = array.get(hist_poc_hi, k)
        float poc_l   = array.get(hist_poc_lo, k)

        // Support: this POC is below current close, and low wicked into it
        if poc_h < close
            float dist = close - poc_h
            if low <= poc_h + sr_zone_pts and close > poc_h
                if dist < best_sup_dist
                    best_sup_dist := dist
                    hit_support   := true
                    support_level := poc_mid

        // Resistance: this POC is above current close, and high wicked into it
        if poc_l > close
            float dist = poc_l - close
            if high >= poc_l - sr_zone_pts and close < poc_l
                if dist < best_res_dist
                    best_res_dist := dist
                    hit_resistance := true
                    resist_level   := poc_mid

    // Find next S/R level for TP targeting
    float best_above = 99999.0
    float best_below = 99999.0
    for k = 0 to hist_size - 1
        float poc_l = array.get(hist_poc_lo, k)
        float poc_h = array.get(hist_poc_hi, k)
        // Nearest resistance above price (for long TP)
        if poc_l > close and poc_l - close < best_above
            best_above := poc_l - close
            next_res_above := poc_l
        // Nearest support below price (for short TP)
        if poc_h < close and close - poc_h < best_below
            best_below := close - poc_h
            next_sup_below := poc_h

    // Also include current POC as potential S/R target
    if not na(poc_hi) and poc_hi > close and poc_hi - close < best_above
        next_res_above := poc_hi
    if not na(poc_lo) and poc_lo < close and close - poc_lo < best_below
        next_sup_below := poc_lo

float long_tp_price  = na
float short_tp_price = na

if long_sig
    if use_sr_tp and not na(next_res_above)
        long_tp_price := math.min(next_res_above, close + tp_pts)
    else
        long_tp_price := close + tp_pts
    if not na(long_tp_price) and long_tp_price - close < 1.0
        long_tp_price := close + tp_pts

if short_sig
    if use_sr_tp and not na(next_sup_below)
        short_tp_price := math.max(next_sup_below, close - tp_pts)
    else
        short_tp_price := close - tp_pts
    if not na(short_tp_price) and close - short_tp_price < 1.0
        short_tp_price := close - tp_pts

int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0
float val_price = na
float vah_price = na

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = math.max(e_row - s_row + 1, 1)

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

    float total_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        total_vol += vol_total.get(r)

    float va_target = total_vol * (va_pct / 100.0)
    int   va_lo_row = poc_row
    int   va_hi_row = poc_row
    float va_vol    = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    int   expand_count = 0

    while va_vol < va_target and expand_count < rows
        expand_count += 1
        float vol_above = va_hi_row < rows - 1 ? vol_total.get(va_hi_row + 1) : -1.0
        float vol_below = va_lo_row > 0 ? vol_total.get(va_lo_row - 1) : -1.0
        if vol_above >= vol_below and va_hi_row < rows - 1
            va_hi_row += 1
            va_vol += vol_total.get(va_hi_row)
        else if va_lo_row > 0
            va_lo_row -= 1
            va_vol += vol_total.get(va_lo_row)
        else if va_hi_row < rows - 1
            va_hi_row += 1
            va_vol += vol_total.get(va_hi_row)
        else
            break

    val_price := prof_lo + va_lo_row * step_size
    vah_price := prof_lo + (va_hi_row + 1) * step_size

bool bos_bear = not na(lower_value) and ta.crossunder(close, lower_value) and not lower_crossed

if bos_bull
    upper_crossed := true
if bos_bear
    lower_crossed := true

bool in_poc_channel = not na(poc_lo) and not na(poc_hi) and close >= poc_lo and close <= poc_hi

var int armed_dir     = 0
var int skip_count   = 0
var int confirm_count = 0
var bool armed_long_pullback  = false
var bool armed_short_pullback = false

if above_poc and delta_bull and vwma_up and armed_dir != 1
    armed_dir     := 1
    confirm_count := 0
    skip_count    := 0
else if below_poc and delta_bear and vwma_dn and armed_dir != -1
    armed_dir     := -1
    confirm_count := 0
    skip_count    := 0

if in_poc_channel and armed_dir != 0
    armed_dir := 0
    confirm_count := 0
    skip_count := 0
    armed_long_pullback := false
    armed_short_pullback := false

if armed_dir == 1
    if close > close[1]
        confirm_count += 1
        skip_count    := 0
    else
        if skip_count < 1
            skip_count += 1
        else
            armed_dir     := 0
            confirm_count := 0
            skip_count    := 0
else if armed_dir == -1
    if close < close[1]
        confirm_count += 1
        skip_count    := 0
    else
        if skip_count < 1
            skip_count += 1
        else
            armed_dir     := 0
            confirm_count := 0
            skip_count    := 0

bool confirmed_long  = armed_dir == 1 and confirm_count >= confirm_candles
bool confirmed_short = armed_dir == -1 and confirm_count >= confirm_candles

if confirmed_long
    armed_long_pullback  := true
    armed_dir            := 0
    confirm_count        := 0
if confirmed_short
    armed_short_pullback := true
    armed_dir            := 0
    confirm_count        := 0

if vwma_dn
    armed_long_pullback := false
if vwma_up
    armed_short_pullback := false

var int last_trade_bar = -9999
bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars

bool long_sig  = armed_long_pullback and near_vwma and vwma_up and in_session and cooled_down and not daily_locked and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = armed_short_pullback and near_vwma and vwma_dn and in_session and cooled_down and not daily_locked and strategy.position_size >= 0

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

            set_low := math.min(set_low, low)

        if gather_count == set_size

            body = math.abs(close - open)
            if body > doji_threshold
                signal_dir := close > open ? 1 : -1
                phase := 1
                watch_count := 0

            set_high := na
            set_low := na

scripts: Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout ES 2min profitable_1792284758.txt

variants.script: Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout ES 2min profitable_1792284758.txt
variants.source:
float poc_price = na
float poc_hi = na
float poc_lo = na
float poc_delta_pct = na

if profile_lookback > 0
    float high_range = high[profile_lookback-1]
    float low_range = low[profile_lookback-1]
    for i = 1 to profile_lookback - 1
        high_range := math.max(high_range, high[i])
        low_range := math.min(low_range, low[i])

    if high_range > low_range
        float range_size = high_range - low_range
        float row_size = range_size / profile_rows
        float poc_vol = 0
        float max_vol = 0
        float current_poc = na

        for r = 0 to profile_rows - 1
            float row_low = low_range + r * row_size
            float row_high = row_low + row_size

            float vol_in_row = 0
            for j = 0 to profile_lookback - 1
                if close[j] >= row_low and close[j] < row_high
                    vol_in_row += volume[j]

            if vol_in_row > max_vol
                max_vol := vol_in_row
                current_poc := (row_low + row_high) / 2

        if not na(current_poc)
            poc_price := current_poc
            poc_hi := current_poc + row_size / 2
            poc_lo := current_poc - row_size / 2

            // Calculate Delta % at POC
            float buy_vol = 0
            float sell_vol = 0
            for j = 0 to profile_lookback - 1
                if close[j] >= poc_lo and close[j] <= poc_hi
                    if close[j] > open[j]
                        buy_vol += volume[j]
                    else
                        sell_vol += volume[j]
            float total_poc_vol = buy_vol + sell_vol
            if total_poc_vol > 0
                poc_delta_pct := math.abs(buy_vol - sell_vol) / total_poc_vol * 100

indicators.summary: Calculated in Large Move Rejection ES.txt.
indicators.source:
move_points   = input.float(20, "Move points", minval=4, maxval=80)
retest_points = input.float(4, "Retest points", minval=0.25, maxval=20)
move_bars     = input.int(30, "Move window bars", minval=8, maxval=120)

move_high = ta.highest(high, move_bars)
move_low = ta.lowest(low, move_bars)
high_off = ta.highestbars(high, move_bars)
low_off = ta.lowestbars(low, move_bars)
move_size = move_high - move_low
large_move = move_size >= move_points
up_move = large_move and high_off < 0 and high_off > low_off
down_move = large_move and low_off < 0 and low_off > high_off

// Remember the extreme. Arm the fade only after a later bar has left it, then take the bar that comes back and closes away.
var float armed_high = na
var float armed_low = na
var bool high_left = false
var bool low_left = false
if up_move
    if na(armed_high) or move_high != armed_high
        armed_high := move_high
        high_left := false
    if high < armed_high - retest_points
        high_left := true
else
    armed_high := na
    high_left := false
if down_move
    if na(armed_low) or move_low != armed_low
        armed_low := move_low
        low_left := false
    if low > armed_low + retest_points
        low_left := true
else
    armed_low := na
    low_left := false
tags_high = not na(armed_high) and high >= armed_high - retest_points and high <= armed_high + retest_points
tags_low = not na(armed_low) and low <= armed_low + retest_points and low >= armed_low - retest_points
short_reject = high_left and tags_high and close < open and close < armed_high - retest_points
long_reject = low_left and tags_low and close > open and close > armed_low + retest_points
if short_reject
    high_left := false
if long_reject
    low_left := false

if in_session and strategy.position_size == 0
    if long_reject
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, comment="Reject low")
    else if short_reject
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, comment="Reject high")

plot(large_move ? move_high : na, "Move high", color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(large_move ? move_low : na, "Move low", color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)

tick_size       = input.float(0.25, "Tick size", minval=0.01)
impulse_ticks   = input.int(250, "Impulse ticks", minval=4, maxval=4000)
impulse_minutes = input.int(15, "Impulse minutes", minval=2, maxval=180)
move_minutes    = input.int(45, "Move minutes", minval=1, maxval=240)
move_points     = input.float(50, "Move points", minval=4, maxval=200)
retest_points   = input.float(5, "Retest points", minval=0.25, maxval=40)
cooldown_bars   = input.int(5, "Cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=100)
daily_profit_cap = input.int(1000, "Daily Profit Cap ($)", minval=0, maxval=10000)
daily_loss_cap   = input.int(750, "Daily Loss Cap ($)", minval=0, maxval=10000)

impulse_points = impulse_ticks * tick_size
impulse_bars = math.max(2, int(math.ceil(impulse_minutes / math.max(timeframe.multiplier, 1))))
burst_high = ta.highest(high, impulse_bars)
burst_low = ta.lowest(low, impulse_bars)
burst_high_off = ta.highestbars(high, impulse_bars)
burst_low_off = ta.lowestbars(low, impulse_bars)
burst = burst_high - burst_low > impulse_points

var int armed = 0
var int dir = 0
var float move_high = na
var float move_low = na
var int extreme_bar = 0
var int arm_time = 0
var int wait_gap = 0

if not in_session
    armed := 0
    dir := 0
    arm_time := 0
    wait_gap := 0

up_burst = burst_high_off > burst_low_off
if in_session and wait_gap == 0 and burst and (armed == 0 or (up_burst and dir != 1) or (not up_burst and dir != -1))
    armed := 1
    dir := up_burst ? 1 : -1
    arm_time := time
    move_high := burst_high
    move_low := burst_low
    extreme_bar := bar_index + (up_burst ? burst_high_off : burst_low_off)

move_limit = arm_time + move_minutes * 60 * 1000
if in_session and armed == 1 and dir == 1 and high > move_high
    if time <= move_limit
        move_high := high
        extreme_bar := bar_index
    else if high > move_high + retest_points
        armed := 0
        dir := 0
        wait_gap := 1
if in_session and armed == 1 and dir == -1 and low < move_low
    if time <= move_limit
        move_low := low
        extreme_bar := bar_index
    else if low < move_low - retest_points
        armed := 0
        dir := 0
        wait_gap := 1
if wait_gap == 1 and not burst
    wait_gap := 0

move_size = move_high - move_low
large_move = armed == 1 and move_size >= move_points
up_move = large_move and dir == 1
down_move = large_move and dir == -1
aged = bar_index >= extreme_bar + 2

// Realized profit for this New York session. The cap uses closed trades. Open profit does not count yet.
var float day_base = 0.0
var int seen_session = 0
if not in_session
    seen_session := 0
if in_session and seen_session == 0
    day_base := strategy.netprofit
    seen_session := 1
day_realized = strategy.netprofit - day_base
day_locked = (daily_profit_cap > 0 and day_realized >= daily_profit_cap) or (daily_loss_cap > 0 and day_realized <= -daily_loss_cap)
if day_locked and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Daily cap")

// The next entry waits until cooldown_bars have passed since the last trade went flat.
var int last_exit_bar = -1000000
var int was_open = 0
if strategy.position_size != 0
    was_open := 1
if was_open == 1 and strategy.position_size == 0
    last_exit_bar := bar_index
    was_open := 0
cooled = bar_index - last_exit_bar >= cooldown_bars

// The bar before this one has left the extreme. This bar comes back within retest_points and closes away.
tags_high = high >= move_high - retest_points and high <= move_high + retest_points
tags_low = low <= move_low + retest_points and low >= move_low - retest_points
short_reject = up_move and aged and high[1] < move_high - retest_points and tags_high and close < open and close < move_high - retest_points
long_reject = down_move and aged and low[1] > move_low + retest_points and tags_low and close > open and close > move_low + retest_points

if in_session and strategy.position_size == 0 and cooled and not day_locked and long_reject
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, comment="Bounce low")
if in_session and strategy.position_size == 0 and cooled and not day_locked and short_reject
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, comment="Reject high")

plot(large_move ? move_high : na, "Move high", color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(large_move ? move_low : na, "Move low", color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)

indicators.summary: Identify impulse: move > impulse_ticks within impulse_minutes
indicators.source:
impulse_len = impulse_minutes * 12 // 5-min chart, 12 bars per hour
impulse_move = high - ta.lowest(low, impulse_len)
impulse_down = ta.highest(high, impulse_len) - low

// Identify move completion: extreme within move_minutes after impulse
move_len = move_minutes * 12
recent_high = ta.highest(high, move_len)
recent_low = ta.lowest(low, move_len)

// Short setup: Impulse up, then retest high and close down
short_signal = false
if impulse_move > impulse_ticks and high == recent_high
    retest_dist = recent_high - low
    if retest_dist <= retest_points * pv and close < open
        short_signal := true

// Buy setup: Impulse down, then retest low and close up
buy_signal = false
if impulse_down > impulse_ticks and low == recent_low
    retest_dist = high - recent_low
    if retest_dist <= retest_points * pv and close > open
        buy_signal := true

indicators.source:
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

float min_price = ta.lowest(low, profile_lookback)
float max_price = ta.highest(high, profile_lookback)
float bin_size = (max_price - min_price) / profile_rows

// Arrays for up/down volume per bin
var array<float> up_vol = array.new_float(profile_rows, 0.0)
var array<float> down_vol = array.new_float(profile_rows, 0.0)

// Reset arrays every bar? No, we need to accumulate over the lookback period.
// But Pine Script arrays persist. We need to clear them and refill every bar.
// This is expensive but necessary for a rolling profile.
array.clear(up_vol)
array.clear(down_vol)
for i = 0 to profile_rows - 1
    array.push(up_vol, 0.0)
    array.push(down_vol, 0.0)

// Fill arrays
for i = 0 to profile_lookback - 1
    float c = close[i]
    float o = open[i]
    float v = volume[i]
    if bin_size > 0
        int idx = int((c - min_price) / bin_size)
        if idx < 0
            idx := 0
        if idx >= profile_rows
            idx := profile_rows - 1
        if c > o
            float current_up = array.get(up_vol, idx)
            array.set(up_vol, idx, current_up + v)
        else
            float current_down = array.get(down_vol, idx)
            array.set(down_vol, idx, current_down + v)

// Find POC index
int poc_idx = 0
float max_vol = 0.0
for i = 0 to profile_rows - 1
    float total_vol = array.get(up_vol, i) + array.get(down_vol, i)
    if total_vol > max_vol
        max_vol := total_vol
        poc_idx := i

// POC Price (center of bin)
float poc_price = min_price + (poc_idx + 0.5) * bin_size
float poc_zone_high = poc_price + poc_zone_rows * bin_size
float poc_zone_low = poc_price - poc_zone_rows * bin_size

// POC Delta
float poc_up = array.get(up_vol, poc_idx)
float poc_down = array.get(down_vol, poc_idx)
float poc_total = poc_up + poc_down
float poc_delta = poc_total > 0 ? (poc_up - poc_down) / poc_total * 100 : 0.0

indicators.source:
bool cross_above_poc = not na(poc_hi) and close > poc_hi and close[1] <= poc_hi
bool cross_below_poc = not na(poc_lo) and close < poc_lo and close[1] >= poc_lo

bool delta_bull = not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct > 0 and (min_delta_pct <= 0 or poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct)
bool delta_bear = not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct < 0 and (min_delta_pct <= 0 or poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct)

bool in_poc_zone = not na(poc_lo) and not na(poc_hi) and close >= poc_lo and close <= poc_hi

var int armed_dir     = 0 // 1: Long, -1: Short, 0: None
var int arm_start_bar = 0

// Update Arm State
if cross_above_poc and vwma_up and delta_bull and armed_dir != 1
    armed_dir     := 1
    arm_start_bar := bar_index
else if cross_below_poc and vwma_dn and delta_bear and armed_dir != -1
    armed_dir     := -1
    arm_start_bar := bar_index

// Disarm if price returns inside POC or wait expires
if armed_dir != 0
    bool expired = bar_index - arm_start_bar >= pivot_wait_bars
    if in_poc_zone or expired
        armed_dir := 0

indicators.name: Pivot Confirmation
indicators.summary: Fractal Pivot Low: Low is lower than pivot_len bars on both sides Fractal Pivot High: High is higher than pivot_len bars on both sides
indicators.source:
bool pivot_low_confirmed = false
bool pivot_high_confirmed = false

if bar_index > pivot_len
    float current_low = low[pivot_len]
    float current_high = high[pivot_len]

    bool is_low_pivot = true
    bool is_high_pivot = true

    for i = 1 to pivot_len
        if low[pivot_len + i] <= current_low or low[pivot_len - i] <= current_low
            is_low_pivot := false
        if high[pivot_len + i] >= current_high or high[pivot_len - i] >= current_high
            is_high_pivot := false

    // Pivot is confirmed at bar_index - pivot_len, but we act on the current bar if the pivot was just confirmed in the past?
    // Standard fractal: The pivot is at bar_index - pivot_len. We know it's a pivot now.
    // We enter on the *current* bar if the condition holds? Or do we enter when the pivot is formed?
    // Plan: "Enter only on a confirmed pivot low... At entry, the VWMA trend and POC delta must still align".
    // Usually, you enter on the bar where the pivot is confirmed (which is pivot_len bars after the pivot point).
    // Let's assume the signal generates on the bar where the pivot is confirmed (current bar).

    if is_low_pivot
        pivot_low_confirmed := true
    if is_high_pivot
        pivot_high_confirmed := true

indicators.summary: Pivot high: current high is the highest of pivot_len bars on each side
indicators.source:
bool pivot_high = false
bool pivot_low  = false
if bar_index >= pivot_len
    pivot_high := true
    pivot_low  := true
    for i = 1 to pivot_len
        if high[bar_index - i] >= high[bar_index - i + 1]
            pivot_high := false
        if low[bar_index - i] <= low[bar_index - i + 1]
            pivot_low := false
    // Confirm: current bar high is >= all bars to the left (already checked) and to the right
    for i = 1 to pivot_len
        if high[bar_index - i] > high
            pivot_high := false
        if low[bar_index - i] < low
            pivot_low := false

indicators.name: Volume Profile With Delta (Prior Bars, Excluding Current)
indicators.signature: Volume Profile With Delta (Prior Bars, Excluding Current)
indicators.summary: Calculated in Day shift BOS Profitable 16k Delta Volume Breakout safe dual time split_1793237253_redesign2.pine.
indicators.source:
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price     = na
float poc_hi        = na
float poc_lo        = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row       = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

indicators.name: Skip Window
indicators.source:
use_skip      = input.bool(true, "Skip This Time Of Day", group="Skip Window", tooltip="No trade opens inside this window, and an open trade is closed when it starts.")
skip_start_hr = input.int(11, "Skip Start Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Skip Window")
skip_start_mn = input.int(30, "Skip Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Skip Window")
skip_end_hr   = input.int(13, "Skip End Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23, group="Skip Window")
skip_end_mn   = input.int(30, "Skip End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59, group="Skip Window")

skip_bar_t = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 100 + minute(time, "America/New_York")
skip_from  = skip_start_hr * 100 + skip_start_mn
skip_to    = skip_end_hr * 100 + skip_end_mn
in_skip_window = use_skip and (skip_from > skip_to ? (skip_bar_t >= skip_from or skip_bar_t < skip_to) : (skip_bar_t >= skip_from and skip_bar_t < skip_to))
skip_window_open = not in_skip_window

if in_skip_window and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Skip Window")
